name: @ciri/bridge
description: Dev-time WebSocket↔TCP bridge so the browser can talk to ciri-server (which speaks ciri-protocol over raw TCP / Unix socket / Named Pipe). Not for production use — no auth, no TLS.

scripts.//start: Pre-build @ciri/codec + @ciri/client before launching so the bridge's `decodeClientHello` import resolves on a fresh checkout (both packages' `dist/` is gitignored). The root `dev` script runs `prebuild-chain` earlier so this is a no-op in that path; the redundant build is cheap because tsc is fully incremental.
scripts.prestart: npm -w @ciri/codec run build && npm -w @ciri/client run build
scripts.preprobe: npm -w @ciri/codec run build && npm -w @ciri/client run build
